findings.title: AssignmentSource.queued default is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: In a Python dataclass, a plain default value is evaluated when the class is defined. `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` therefore assigns the same module-import timestamp to every AssignmentSource created without an explicit `queued` value, including `from_integration()` and `from_dict()` when `queued` is omitted. This makes the timestamp stale and misleading for diagnostics or any future dedupe/TTL logic. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

findings.title: Celery kwargs receive a dict containing a datetime object
findings.body: `sync_group_assignee_outbound` passes `assignment_source.to_dict()` as Celery task kwargs. `AssignmentSource.to_dict()` uses `dataclasses.asdict()`, so the `queued` field remains a `datetime` object. Task payloads should be JSON-safe primitives; depending on the Celery serializer this can make `apply_async` fail, or it can be serialized to a string that `AssignmentSource.from_dict()` does not convert back to a datetime. Serialize `queued` explicitly, for example as an ISO-8601 string, and normalize it in `from_dict`.

findings.title: Task assumes all installations accept the new should_sync argument
findings.body: The outbound task now calls `installation.should_sync("outbound_assignee", parsed_assignment_source)` and later passes `assignment_source` to `sync_assignee_outbound`. Integrations or plugins that still implement the previous one-argument `should_sync` or a `sync_assignee_outbound` method without `**kwargs` will raise TypeError at runtime. If custom or third-party integrations are supported, this signature change needs compatibility handling or documentation.

findings.title: No test that deassignment from the same integration is suppressed
findings.body: The added tests cover assignment with a matching AssignmentSource, but the deassignment path also accepts and forwards `assignment_source`, including from `sync_group_assignee_inbound`. There is no test asserting that `GroupAssignee.objects.deassign(..., assignment_source=AssignmentSource.from_integration(integration))` does not trigger outbound sync to that same integration.
